title: Setting the Deposit Against What Is Left on a Resort Lodging Folio
content:
The deposit taken before a Resort Lodging stay is set against what is left to be collected on the folio. What stands as a deposit against the reservation is read from the deposit entries on the folio, net of what has already been applied or returned.

Where a deposit stands against the reservation and reaches what is left to be collected, only what is left to be collected is set against it and the balance of the deposit is returned to the household.

Where a deposit stands against the reservation and falls short of what is left to be collected, the whole of the deposit standing is set against it.

Where no deposit stands against the reservation, nothing is set against it.

| What the reservation's deposit shows | What is set against what is left |
| --- | --- |
| A deposit standing that reaches what is left to be collected | only what is left to be collected, the balance of the deposit being returned to the household |
| A deposit standing that falls short of what is left to be collected | the whole of the deposit standing |
| No deposit standing | nothing |

### Both sides of the boundary (hypothetical reservations where 900.00 USD is left to be collected)

A deposit of 1400.00 USD standing against the reservation reaches the 900.00 USD left to be collected, so 900.00 USD is set against it and the remaining 500.00 USD of the deposit is returned to the household.

A deposit of 900.00 USD standing reaches it exactly, so the whole 900.00 USD is set against it and nothing of the deposit is left to return.

A deposit of 350.00 USD standing falls short, so the whole 350.00 USD is set against what is left. Where no deposit stands against the reservation at all, nothing is set against it.
